grades.quote: If supervisor mode is implemented, its mip.STIP and mie.STIE are the interrupt-pending and interruptenable bits for supervisor-level timer interrupts. If the stimecmp register is not implemented, STIP is writable in mip, and may be written by M-mode software to deliver timer interrupts to S-mode. If the `stimecmp` (supervisor-mode timer compare) register is implemented, STIP is read-only in mip and reflects the supervisor-level timer interrupt signal resulting from stimecmp. This timer interrupt signal is cleared by writing `stimecmp` with a value greater than the current time value.
